class.name: SubtitlePlayback
class.brief_description: Plays a [Subtitle] against a time you provide and signals when segments start and end.

method.name: get_active_segments
method.description: Returns the segments that are active at [method get_time], sorted by start time. Overlapping segments are all included.

method.name: get_current_segment
method.description: Returns the active segment that started last, or [code]null[/code] if no segment is active. This is the segment of the last [signal segment_changed].

method.name: get_time
method.description: Returns the time of the last [method update] or [method seek], in seconds. Returns [code]0.0[/code] after [method reset].

method.name: reset
method.description: Ends all active segments: emits [signal segment_ended] for each of them, then [signal segment_changed] with [code]null[/code]. The playback forgets its time, so the next [method update] does not report skipped segments.

method.name: seek
method.description: Jumps to [param time], forward or backward. Only the segments that are active before or after the jump are reported: segments in between are skipped silently.

method.name: update
method.description: Moves to [param time], usually once per frame. If [param time] is later than the previous time, segments that started and ended in between (after a long frame, or while a browser tab was hidden) still emit [signal segment_started] and [signal segment_ended], but no [signal segment_changed]. If [param time] is earlier, this works like [method seek].

members.member: The subtitle to play. Assigning another subtitle first calls [method reset].

signal.name: segment_changed
signal.description: Emitted after [signal segment_ended] and [signal segment_started] when the current segment changes (see [method get_current_segment]). [param segment] is [code]null[/code] when no segment is active. Connect this signal to show one line of text.

signal.name: segment_ended
signal.description: Emitted when [param segment] stops being active: its end time has passed, the time jumped away from it, or [method reset] was called.

signal.name: segment_started
signal.description: Emitted when [param segment] becomes active. Connect this signal and [signal segment_ended] to show overlapping segments at the same time.
